block_node.block_desc: Clusters data using the DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) algorithm. The block is capable of clustering any type of data and has features to assist with epsilon parameter estimation and disambiguation.

Model the motion and signal reflection from a bicyclist. The bicyclist model is composed of 5 primary parts: bicycle frame and upper-body of rider, pedals, legs, front wheel, and rear wheel. Each part is composed of individual point scatterers, and the total number of point scatterers in the target model is dependent on the number of spokes defined. Each scatterer has its own motion when the bicyclist moves. The reflected signal is the sum of the reflections from each scatterer.

Model the motion and signal reflection from a pedestrian. The pedestrian consists of 16 body parts, and each part has its own motion when the pedestrian moves. The reflected signal is the sum of the reflected signals from each body part.

Propagate narrowband signals from one point in space to multiple points or from multiple points back to one point via both the direct path and the ground reflection path. The block models propagation time, free-space propagation loss, and Doppler shift. The block assumes that the propagation speed is much greater than the object's speed in which case the stop-and-hop model is valid.

Propagate signals from one point in space to multiple points or from multiple points back to one point via both the direct path and the ground reflection path. The block can propagate wideband signals by dividing them into subbands. The block models propagation time, free-space propagation loss, and Doppler shift. The block assumes that the propagation speed is much greater than the object's speed in which case the stop-and-hop model is valid.
Generate a barrage jammer signal. The barrage jammer is a wideband noise jammer.
Generate pulse waveforms from a user-defined library containing linear FM, phase-coded, rectangular, stepped FM, and custom waveforms. You can specify the parameters of each waveform.

Perform matched filtering or stretch processing based on user defined library to compute the range response of the input signal. The output response is a matrix or a 3-dimensional array whose rows represent range gates.

Generate constant gamma clutter reflected from homogeneous terrain for a monostatic radar transmitting a narrowband signal into free space. The radar is assumed to be at constant altitude traveling at a constant speed.

Sensor simulation block used to generate radar detections and tracks from simulated target poses. Target reports are generated at the sensor's update rate. A statistical model generates measurement noise, true target reports, and false alarms. The random numbers used by the statistical model are controlled by the random number generator settings on the Measurements tab.

Combines object detection buses from multiple sensors onto a single output bus. Sensors include the Radar Detection Generator and Vision Detection Generator blocks. This is useful when detections from multiple sensor blocks are passed into a Multi-Object Tracker block.

Generate, using the GPU, constant gamma clutter reflected from homogeneous terrain for a monostatic radar transmitting a narrowband signal into free space. The radar is assumed to be at constant altitude travelling at a constant speed. Use of this object requires a Parallel Computing Toolbox license.
